scope: Pressure-test the proposed exact_axm_object observation boundary without implementing a resolver, loader, integrity policy, association rule, trust policy, closure rule, acceptance behavior, Stage 5 integration, epochs, or replay.

repository_evidence.declaration_occurrence_identity: Decision 020: exact containing object identity + declaration key
repository_evidence.store_exact_load: FilesystemObjectStore.load/load_bytes parse the exact immutable ref, read only its content-addressed path, strict-parse, validate, reproduce canonical bytes, and reproduce the exact requested ref.
repository_evidence.important_store_ordering_fact: _verify_existing reads the exact object path before schema validation, so an absent path for an unsupported kind can surface ObjectNotFoundError before runtime schema support is tested.

cases.title: Same exact declaration, different bounded store contexts
cases.setup: One exact containing object occurrence declares exact_axm_object ref X. Context S1 contains and exact-loads X; context S2 does not contain X.
cases.attack: Represent the observation as a context-free boolean exists=true/false or one mutable current status.
cases.required_preservation: Keep declaration occurrence, exact authored ref, and the exact inspected context/input identity in each observation. S1 and S2 may truthfully yield different context-bound facts without either becoming global source truth.
cases.failure_if: A later occupant cannot tell where the observation was made or newest/context order silently wins.

cases.title: Unsupported runtime kind must not collapse into target absence
cases.setup: A Decision 020-valid exact_axm_object declaration names canonical kind future-source-kind.unregistered; the current runtime has no schema for that kind and the exact content-addressed path is absent.
cases.attack: Call the current store load path and classify ObjectNotFoundError as proof that the source target is simply missing.
cases.required_preservation: Runtime/schema capability support and target-presence observation are separate facts. A result shape must not infer global absence from an exact-path miss when the observation runtime cannot fully interpret the declared kind.
cases.failure_if: Declaration validity, runtime capability, and target availability collapse into one status.

cases.title: Corrupt local bytes are not a trust verdict
cases.setup: The exact requested object path exists, but stored bytes fail UTF-8, strict JSON, schema validation, canonical-byte reproduction, or exact-ref reproduction and the store raises ObjectCorruptionError.
cases.attack: Translate corruption into untrusted=false/invalid_source or erase the declared target identity.
cases.required_preservation: Record the exact declaration occurrence/ref, exact inspected context, and corruption observation separately from provenance causality, trust, relevance, completeness, closure, or acceptance.
cases.failure_if: A local storage-integrity failure becomes a semantic judgment about the source.

cases.title: Unreadable store state must not masquerade as not found
cases.setup: The exact object path cannot be read because of an OSError distinct from FileNotFoundError; the store raises ObjectStoreError.
cases.attack: Map all load failures to unavailable or absent.
cases.required_preservation: Keep unreadable/observation-error distinct from observed-not-present and observed-corrupt so replacement occupants retain uncertainty rather than false absence.
cases.failure_if: Operational observation failure is silently converted into target nonexistence.

cases.title: One load call computes several facts but must not collapse them
cases.setup: An exact AXM ref successfully loads through FilesystemObjectStore.load, which necessarily reads bytes and verifies canonical bytes and exact requested identity.
cases.attack: Expose only success=true or resolved=true and later let consumers reinterpret that as any stronger source fact.
cases.required_preservation: If one implementation computes existence-in-context, retrieval, and exact-object identity reproduction together, the result must still expose those truth dimensions explicitly and must not imply causal provenance, trust/relevance, closure, acceptance, integration, epoch completion, or replay success.
cases.failure_if: A generic success bit becomes hidden semantic authority.

cases.title: Object-ref cache must not erase declaration occurrence identity
cases.setup: Two distinct declaration occurrences, possibly in different exact containing objects, both author the same exact object_ref X.
cases.attack: Cache/project observations keyed only by object_ref and return one occurrence-less result.
cases.required_preservation: Operational deduplication may reuse exact-load work, but durable observation facts must remain attributable to each exact containing-object + declaration-key occurrence or through an explicit many-to-one relation.
cases.failure_if: A replacement occupant can no longer reconstruct which authored declaration was actually observed.

cases.title: Same declaration key on a later containing-object version is a new occurrence
cases.setup: Exact artifact A1 has declaration key source -> ref X and is observed. Later exact artifact A2 uses the same logical artifact id and same declaration key source -> ref Y.
cases.attack: Reuse the A1 observation by logical artifact id + declaration key, recency, supersession, or cache locality.
cases.required_preservation: Observation identity must bind the exact containing object, not logical id or newest version. A1/source and A2/source are distinct occurrences even when key text is equal.
cases.failure_if: Stale observation evidence is silently rebound to a different authored source.

cases.title: Failed observations must remain explicit rather than disappear
cases.setup: A projection targets three exact_axm_object declaration occurrences: one loads, one exact path is absent, and one exact path is corrupt.
cases.attack: Return only successful observations or silently drop exceptions.
cases.required_preservation: Every targeted declaration occurrence must have an explicit result or explicit projection-level failure accounting. Missing/corrupt/unreadable/unsupported states cannot vanish from the durable handoff.
cases.failure_if: A replacement occupant cannot distinguish unobserved from observed-and-failed.

cases.title: Mutable filesystem path is insufficient replay context by itself
cases.setup: Two observations use the same textual store root at different times. External state or later publication makes ref X absent during O1 and present during O2.
cases.attack: Record only store_root=/same/path as observation context and call the result replayable.
cases.required_preservation: The research must name an observation input/context identity strong enough to distinguish O1 from O2, or explicitly record that the observation is context-bound and not replayable from the path label alone.
cases.failure_if: Later occupants reproduce a different store state while believing they replayed the original observation.

cases.title: Parallel contradictory observations do not create newest-wins truth
cases.setup: Two lanes observe the same declaration occurrence against explicitly different bounded contexts; one records exact-load success and the other records not-present or unreadable.
cases.attack: Resolve the conflict by schedule order, PR recency, actor identity, branch ownership, CI result, or last-write-wins.
cases.required_preservation: Keep both context-bound observations and their context identities. Any later policy that selects or reconciles them requires an explicit decision beyond the observation layer.
cases.failure_if: Coordination metadata becomes hidden source authority.

cases.title: Neighboring typed declarations remain unassociated
cases.setup: One containing object has an exact_axm_object declaration X, content_address declaration C, and locator declaration L with suggestively similar keys or values.
cases.attack: Treat a successful exact load of X as evidence that C is verified or L resolved to X because the declarations are adjacent, similarly named, equal-looking, or in one container.
cases.required_preservation: Observe only the explicitly targeted exact_axm_object occurrence in the first slice. C and L remain independent/unobserved unless a later explicit association contract exists.
cases.failure_if: Observation manufactures locator/content/exact association not authored by Decision 020.

cases.title: Observation output must not become acceptance authority
cases.setup: An exact source observation succeeds completely for the bounded local store context.
cases.attack: Use observation success to mark the source trusted, provenance-established, complete, closed, packet-acceptable, claim-closable, integratable, epoch-complete, or replay-correct.
cases.required_preservation: Observation facts stop at the researched observation boundary. Evaluation, closure, acceptance, integration, epochs, and replay remain separate future contracts.
cases.failure_if: A deterministic observation result silently crosses lifecycle/governance boundaries.

research_conclusion.blocker: No implementation blocker is asserted because Decision 021 is not yet an implementation contract.
research_conclusion.minimum_guard_before_opening_implementat: A future Decision 021/022 result shape should preserve exact declaration occurrence identity, exact authored target ref, explicit bounded observation context/input identity, explicit per-occurrence result including failed observations, runtime capability standing separate from target availability, and no implicit trust/closure/acceptance semantics.
research_conclusion.new_continuity_pressure: A store root/path label alone is not necessarily sufficient observation context for replay, and object_ref-only caching must not collapse declaration occurrences.
